decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) a complex multi-axis step-and-decay event centered near index 440–445 with a later isolated U-spike near 520–525; (2) the onset of coherent linear trends across N/E/U starting at index 725, indicating a possible sustained offset or platform.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample upward jump in N and E (≈+10 MAD) near index 440–445, followed by a slower decay and partial return; U shows a concurrent smaller upward step then gradual decline. A second abrupt negative spike in U at ~520–525 with no clear counterpart in N/E suggests possible local disturbance or measurement artifact.

From ~725 onward, all three components show coherent linear trends: N rises steadily, E declines steadily, U rises steadily—suggesting a sustained platform-like motion or systematic bias shift. The transition from noisy fluctuation to smooth monotonic behavior begins around index 725 and is fully evident by 729.
